data.name: Isac
data.gender_notes: Isac is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew name 'Yitzchak' meaning 'he who laughs', this name is given to boys in the Bible and in Christian traditions. It was bestowed upon the son of Abraham and Sarah, who was considered a miracle birth due to their old age. The name is associated with God's promise to reward Abraham and Sarah with a child. The name Isac carries the meaning “God's reward” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Isac usually hope their child will grow to embody god's reward and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Isac total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
